def process(load_reports) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_reports.dropna(how='all').drop_duplicates()
    df = df[df['Year'].notna() & (df['Year'] != 'Year')]
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['Year'].notna()]
    for col in ['Fraud ', 'Identity Theft ', 'Other ']:
        df[col] = df[col].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna()
    return df
input.summary: Clean the reports data: remove null rows and duplicates, convert Year and report counts to numeric, remove commas from numbers, filter to valid data rows

def process(clean_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = clean_data.copy()
    df['Total'] = df['Fraud '] + df['Identity Theft '] + df['Other ']
    df['Other_Ratio'] = df['Other '] / df['Total']
    df['Other_More_Than_Half'] = df['Other_Ratio'] > 0.5
    return df[['Year', 'Fraud ', 'Identity Theft ', 'Other ', 'Total', 'Other_Ratio', 'Other_More_Than_Half']]
